title: Telltale config
description: Screens, widgets and Signal K bindings for a Telltale display (docs/SPEC.md §6). The firmware's own checks (src/config.c) are the reference; this schema mirrors them. Per-type widget details also come from GET /api/widgets.

hostname.description: mDNS name (<hostname>.local). A change applies after a restart.

host.description: Server host or IP. Empty: find the server by mDNS (_signalk-ws._tcp).

screens.description: Swipeable screens, left to right. Screen ids must be unique.

clock.description: Local time for clock times (tide highs and lows). Without offset_path, times show in UTC and say so.

offset_path.description: Signal K path with the UTC offset as (-)hhmm, e.g. environment.time.timezoneOffset (signalk-ships-time).

auto_screen.description: Switch screens from a Signal K text value, e.g. navigation.state. Acts when the value changes; a swipe holds the chosen screen for manual_hold_s.

widgets.description: Widgets may not overlap or leave the grid.

label.description: value, ring, bar, state: defaults to the Signal K displayName, then the path's last element. label: required.

min.description: ring, bar: scale start, in SI like the data.

max.description: ring, bar (required): scale end, in SI like the data (ratio 1 = 100 %). More than min.

api.description: tide (required): tides API base on the Signal K server, e.g. /signalk/v2/api/tides/stations/vessel/default (signalk-tides).

history.description: anchor: Signal K History API values endpoint (e.g. /signalk/v2/api/history/values); the trail is filled from it so it survives restarts. Absent: trail from boot.

orientation.description: bar. Default: vertical if the cell is taller than wide.

states.description: state: how each value is shown. Values not listed are shown as received, in the normal colour.

value.description: As received; numbers as written ("0", "1.5"); booleans "true"/"false". Unique.

text.description: Shown instead of the value. Default: the value.

position.description: anchor: the boat's position, e.g. navigation.position.

anchor.description: anchor: the anchor's position, e.g. navigation.anchor.position.

radius.description: anchor: alarm circle radius (m), e.g. navigation.anchor.maxRadius.

heading.description: anchor (optional): heading for the boat mark, e.g. navigation.headingTrue.

notifications.description: alert: which Signal K notifications to show. anchor (optional): alarm under this prefix turns the plot red.

prefix.description: Path under notifications. (either form), e.g. electrical.batteries. Absent or empty: all.

unit.description: Display unit (Signal K values are SI). Omitted: the server's displayUnits, else SI.

stale_after_s.description: Age (from the server's timestamp) after which the value is shown dimmed.

zones.description: Override the zones in Signal K metadata. Limits in SI. The most severe zone containing the value wins.
